text: Well, Stephanie, since Leonard seems to be dropping the conversational ball, I guess I'll just have to pick it up.

text: Have you ever witnessed a violent crime?

text: Hmm, technically not a fruit, but all right. Where did you do your medical internship?

text: Uh, Lawrence Memorial in Galveston, Texas.

text: Really? That's where I was born!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I spent so much of my childhood at that hospital. When I was 12, I got to ride there in a helicopter.

text: Radiation burns. A little mishap while I was building my own cat scanner.

text: I'm sorry, you tried to build your own cat scanner?

text: No, I didn't try, I succeeded. In fact, I was briefly able to see the inside of my sister's guinea pig, Snowball, before he caught fire. It led to an interesting expression in our house, not a snowball's chance in a cat scanner.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Excuse me. When I come back, just for fun, the subject will be alternative history. Specifically, how would the civil war have gone differently if Lincoln had been a robot sent from the future?
